header: Three shippers, three delivery problems solved

cases.summary: Chilled groceries now leave Oslo at 21:00 and reach 34 stores before opening, which let the retailer cut its own night fleet from 12 trucks to 4.
Line-side parts arrive in four fixed windows a day at Wolfsburg, so the plant stopped holding a 5,000-unit buffer inside the gate.
Bonded loads clear customs in 41 minutes on average. Before the Eindhoven depot took over the paperwork, the same lane lost a full afternoon.
